available_fullmix_lowband_descriptors_no.decision: All four numeric low-band descriptors were evaluated in a separate 20-feature feature set. That set performed WORSE (balanced accuracy 0.7333 versus 0.7642 for the source-neutral set under the same pre-scaling protocol), so the source-neutral set was kept. They are FullMix-derived, not stem-derived, so they were not excluded on leakage grounds.

excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.multi_stem_witness.*: STEM-DERIVED (Demucs). Excluded entirely; never predictor, never Ground Truth.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.candidate_arms / arm_populated_arms / ar: Method L selection state. Prohibited. Excluded.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.timestamp_s / native_sample / frame_inde: Absolute track time and musical position. Prohibited. Excluded.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.event_id: Join key only. Never a predictor.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.pitch_continuity_status: Constant on all 32 eligible rows. Zero variance.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.harmonic_count: Constant on all 32 eligible rows. Zero variance.
excluded_for_leakage_or_prohibition.PLP distance / PLP phase / quarter numbe: Explicitly prohibited by the PI. None is present in the Phase A feature matrix; none was computed, read or used.

feature_provenance_audit.method: Each candidate was traced to its extractor call and to the fields of the Phase A table.
feature_provenance_audit.argument: The Phase A feature table was produced the day BEFORE the human Bass labels existed, so no feature could have been created using them, the Bass-vs-not-Bass outcome, or any held-out information.
feature_provenance_audit.extractor_prohibition_assertion: REPRODUCTION/producer.py states: 'Prohibited by PI decision and asserted at runtime: PLP, Method L, quarter/measure' and its excluded list matches the schema.

frozen_feature.name: peak_prominence
frozen_feature.definition: scipy find_peaks prominence at the candidate frame (FullMix).
